The '''PR-3''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] produced by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
